files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "campus-cli"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Campus inventory command-line tool"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/praxbit/campus-cli"
keywords = ["inventory", "campus"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities"]
exclude = [".env", "fixtures/private/*"]

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1.0.203", features = ["derive"] }
